name: 0-10V Ballast Dimmer
description: A controller for dimmable lighting ballasts that use a 0-10 VDC control input. It also has two relay outputs that can switch non-dimmable ballasts of up to 5 amps each.
notes: HouseLinc names it Insteon Ballast Dimmer.
Drives a 0-10 V output and two relayed loads; on cmd1 0x11 or 0x13, cmd2 0x01 selects load 1, 0x02 load 2 and 0x03 both.
Each input line is normally high. Input 1 sends on to group 1 when it goes low and to group 2 when it goes high; input 2 sends on to group 3 when it goes low and to group 4 when it goes high.
A change on an input can also change the load, using the on mask, on level and ramp rate stored for groups 2 to 5, one for each of the four transitions.
Its PRD lists one controller group and gives the inputs as a firmware update, so some versions may not send to groups 2 to 4.
